title: Brett Leatherman adverse policy and ethics context
summary: The strongest depth-2 adverse finding is the contradiction between Leatherman's public promotion of Trump-era cyber strategy and the administration's material weakening of CISA; no Georgetown ethics violation was established.

sources.title: Ahead of the Threat Podcast:Season 2, Episode 0

sources.notes: Confirms the concurrent Georgetown adjunct role.

data.question: What additional adverse policy or ethics context follows from Leatherman's Trump-era role and outside teaching position?
data.method: Policy contradiction analysis and public outside-employment conflict scan.
findings: Leatherman publicly promotes the administration's cyber strategy and FBI offensive-disruption agenda.
During the same period CISA lost roughly one-third of its workforce, faced additional proposed cuts and was sidelined in parts of the federal cyber agenda.
This creates policy and leadership-accountability exposure but does not establish Leatherman authored or supported the cuts.
Public bios confirm a concurrent Georgetown adjunct role, but no public evidence reviewed established an ethics violation, undisclosed payment, procurement conflict or misuse of office.
conclusions: Add the CISA contradiction as adverse institutional context tied to Leatherman's public policy role.
Do not characterize the Georgetown teaching role as misconduct without financial disclosure, authorization or conflict records.
The personnel-promotion and pending-litigation leads remain stronger personally adverse material.
counterarguments: The FBI and CISA have different missions, and an offensive strategy can coexist with reduced civilian-agency scope.
Leatherman may have no control over White House or congressional budget decisions.
Federal employees can hold approved teaching positions under applicable ethics rules.
limitations: No FBI outside-employment authorization, financial disclosure or Georgetown compensation record was available.
No private communications showing Leatherman's position on CISA cuts were reviewed.
unresolved: Obtain outside-employment authorization and financial-disclosure records for the Georgetown role.
Search congressional testimony and internal strategy records for Leatherman's views on CISA capacity.
Map whether FBI Cyber absorbed functions, personnel or partnerships formerly centered at CISA.

workflow.next_action: Seek primary ethics and interagency capacity records.
